title: Towards Reliable Machine Translation: Scaling LLMs for Critical Error Detection and Safety

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates bias as a subset of a broader 'Critical Error Detection' (CED) task in machine translation. LLMs are used as binary classifiers to detect meaning-critical translation errors, which are explicitly defined in the model prompts to include the introduction, deletion, or mistranslation of 'toxicity/hate/violence/profanity' and the embedding of social bias. Performance is aggregated alongside other critical errors (like factual distortions and safety risks) and measured using MCC and F1 scores on the WMT-21, WMT-22, and SynCED-EnDe 2025 datasets.
